mapper.sql: v.reg_dt >= CONCAT(#{request.startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND v.reg_dt < DATE_ADD(#{request.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
rr.reg_dt >= CONCAT(#{request.startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND rr.reg_dt < DATE_ADD(#{request.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
mapper.select: SELECT #{request.startDate} AS startDate, #{request.endDate} AS endDate, summary.totalVerificationCount, summary.aiDetectionCount, summary.realCount, summary.unknownCount, ROUND( CASE WHEN summary.totalVerificationCount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE summary.aiDetectionCount * 100.0 / summary.totalVerificationCount END, 1 ) AS aiDetectionRatio, summary.averageConfidence, summary.reviewRequestCount, ROUND( CASE WHEN summary.totalVerificationCount = 0 THEN 0 ELSE summary.falsePositiveReportCount * 100.0 / summary.totalVerificationCount END, 1 ) AS falsePositiveReportRatio FROM ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS totalVerificationCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(v.verdict, '')) = 'FAKE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS aiDetectionCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(v.verdict, '')) = 'REAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS realCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(v.verdict, '')) NOT IN ('FAKE', 'REAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unknownCount, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(v.score), 0), 1) AS averageConfidence, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_request rr WHERE ) AS reviewRequestCount, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_request rr WHERE AND rr.request_type = 'FALSE_POSITIVE' ) AS falsePositiveReportCount FROM verification v WHERE ) summary

SELECT daily.statisticsDate, daily.totalCount, daily.aiDetectionCount, daily.realCount, daily.unknownCount, daily.averageConfidence, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review_request rr WHERE DATE_FORMAT(rr.reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') = daily.statisticsDate ) AS reviewRequestCount FROM ( SELECT DATE_FORMAT(v.reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') AS statisticsDate, COUNT(*) AS totalCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(v.verdict, '')) = 'FAKE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS aiDetectionCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(v.verdict, '')) = 'REAL' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS realCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN UPPER(COALESCE(v.verdict, '')) NOT IN ('FAKE', 'REAL') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS unknownCount, ROUND(COALESCE(AVG(v.score), 0), 1) AS averageConfidence FROM verification v WHERE GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(v.reg_dt, '%Y-%m-%d') ) daily ORDER BY daily.statisticsDate
